text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. I received a message from Orfevre 
telling me to "Come at once," so I rushed 
over.
choice_data_list: Did you need something from me—
Did you need something from me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, Orfevre glared at me! 
Under those piercing eyes, I couldn't stop 
trembling...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Consider this an admonition. Exhausting 
all your strength in vain is the height of 
folly. ...Reflect upon your own 
foolishness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems running back-to-back races has 
caused a significant amount of fatigue to 
build up. I need to rethink her rotation 
immediately...!
